name: IntelliMagic Vision for SAN
description_en:
IntelliMagic Vision for SAN is a product in the Network monitoring category. Its directory profile covers Uptime Monitoring, Real Time Analytics, Baseline Manager, Resource Management.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large). API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Offers Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: check whether selected services respond as expected; allocate people, time and other project resources. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
